subject: Observability add-ons pricing: retention, tracing, dashboards + migration credit?
messages:
From: Ari Hoffman <ari@finlytics.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing and migration credit?

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick demo earlier. FinLytics is evaluating Redwood for model hosting and we expect to adopt your hosted inference API next quarter, but we need clarity on the add-on economics before we move to procurement. Two quick asks: pricing detail for (a) increased retention (log + token traces) beyond default 30 days, (b) distributed tracing / flamegraphs for tail latency, and (c) advanced dashboards (custom metrics / alerting / scheduled snapshots).

Specifically: 1) can you map out SKU-style pricing for retention buckets (30/90/365 days), 2) tracing — is that priced per trace, per million traces, or per-host? 3) dashboards — seat or metered? 4) what volume discounts look like at 6–12M tokens/month and 12+M tokens/month.

Separately, we have a non-trivial migration (20M tokens/month average today, expect to double). Procurement asked whether Redwood provides one-time migration or transition credits to offset up-front indexing/tracing ingestion costs. If so, what are typical ranges and conditions?

Attaching a short RFP and current usage snapshot. We aim to get terms nailed down by end of month. Can you send a short, line-item proposal we can share with our finance team?

Thanks,
Ari Hoffman
Head of ML Ops, FinLytics
ari@finlytics.ai

Attachments: FinLytics_RFP_v1.pdf
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Hoffman <ari@finlytics.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing and migration credit?

Hi Ari — great to connect earlier. Looping Ben (sales ops) and Marissa (Head of Commercials) to make sure pricing and any concessions are aligned. Below is a concise line-item take; happy to iterate after we see your usage attachment.

High-level add-on pricing (starter proposal):
- Retention (log/token storage):
  - 30 days (default): included for free
  - 90 days: $0.08 per 1K tokens stored / month
  - 365 days: $0.18 per 1K tokens stored / month
  - Notes: pricing reflects tiered storage; we can add an archival cold tier for infrequent access at 365+ days.

- Distributed tracing (tail trace capture + flamegraphs):
  - Base: $0.03 per 1K traces (sampling-based model)
  - High-volume / all-span capture: $0.40 per 1M spans ingested / month
  - Includes trace indexing and per-trace query credits (query credits are metered; see sheet).

- Advanced dashboards & scheduled snapshots:
  - Dashboard Pro seat: $45 / seat / month (includes advanced widgets, scheduled snapshot exports)
  - Enterprise bundle (unlimited dashboards, alerting, SSO): starts at $2,500 / month (up to 25 seats)

Volume discounting (token commitments):
- 0–5M tokens/mo: list pricing
- 5–12M tokens/mo: 10% discount on add-on unit rates
- 12M+ tokens/mo: 18% discount on add-on unit rates
- Multi-year commits get an additional 3–7% depending on length and reserve.

Migration / transition credits (one-time):
- We offer limited migration credits tied to committed spend. Typical structure:
  - $15k credit for a 6-month committed plan (min spend threshold)
  - $25k credit for 12-month firm commitment (preferred)
  - For larger migrations we can scale credits (case-by-case) — need committed ARR threshold and signature timeline.

Fast next steps: if you can share a 6–12 month expected token profile and what % of traces you expect to capture (sampled vs all), Ben and I will draft a line-item SOW with projected month-by-month costs and an explicit migration credit offer. I attached a compact pricing-sheet for reference.

Calendly to pick a follow-up: https://cal.com/karthik/redwood-demo

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx
From: Ari Hoffman <ari@finlytics.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finlytics.ai
Date: 2026-07-21T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing and migration credit?

Thanks Karthik — this is very helpful. A few clarifications and a counterproposal from procurement:

- Current baseline: ~20M tokens/mo today, expect to ramp to ~40–45M within 6 months after cutover.
- Trace capture: we plan to sample ~8% of requests initially; long-term we may move to 20% during peak windows.

Counter/asks:
1) Migration credit: procurement is asking for $50k one-time credit to offset ingestion/indexing costs during our first 3 months post-cutover.
2) Dashboards: can you include Dashboard Pro (up to 10 seats) at no charge for the first 6 months if we sign a 12-month commitment?
3) Unit rates: can you shave another 5% off the 12M+ token tier if we commit to 12 months and provide a PO within 10 business days?

Timeline: we’re hoping to have a signed SOW by July 31. Do you have internal approval bandwidth to confirm concessions before then?

Appreciate it — if you can confirm in writing we’ll route to legal/procurement.

—Ari
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Hoffman <ari@finlytics.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-23T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention + tracing + dashboards — pricing and migration credit?

Hi Ari — looping in final approvals. Thank you for the clear asks; we want to make this a smooth migration for FinLytics. We can support the following concessions to enable a July close: 

Approved concessions (conditional):
- One-time migration credit: $35,000 credit applied against first invoice. Conditional on a 12-month committed spend (minimum committed ARR to be reflected in SOW) and signature within 10 business days of the final SOW.
- Dashboards: Dashboard Pro — up to 6 seats free for the first 90 days (we can expand to 10 seats for co-marketing commitments; discuss separately).
- Unit pricing: an additional 5% off the 12M+ token tier for a 12-month firm commitment and PO issued within 10 business days.
- Trial: we will provide a 30-day ingestion waiver (no charge for trace ingestion up to agreed sampling %) during the initial 30-day cutover window.

Next steps: Karthik / Ben — please prepare a redlined SOW reflecting the $35k migration credit, the dashboard seat concession, the 5% list reduction, and the 30-day ingestion waiver. Include an explicit termination clause tied to committed minimum spend. Once ready, we’ll send a DocuSign link for signature.

Ari — I’m also attaching the approved SOW redline for transparency. If FinLytics needs the $50k ask, we can revisit as part of a pilot/top-up program after month three (needs exec review).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercials — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: approved_sow_redlined.pdf
